posts.trend: 250+ job applications, zero callbacks: IIM Kozhikode MBA grad asks if anyone is hiring
posts.context: The promise that elite academic credentials guarantee a secure and comfortable adulthood has expired.
posts.angle: The institutional brands that you spent your youth competing to enter have been reduced to content pieces for job boards.
slides: Go and look at your degree certificate in the folder.

In 2016: "Get this brand, your life is sorted."

In 2021: "The network is your net worth."

In 2026: 250 applications, 0 callbacks, 1 LinkedIn post asking for a referral.

The premium subscription didn't help.

The platform is still charging you.
posts.caption: The gold medal has been archived. 📁
posts.rank_verdict: A strong, resonant post, though the transition from the physical degree to a digital subscription in the landing is slightly loose.
